name: Transitland
description: A transit provider: the departures and service alerts of the stops you list (My Stops), from Transitland, for the transit pages and overlays. Holds the API key and the answers they share. Not a real-time display: an answer is kept at least 15 minutes, so every board says how old it is.

properties.name: apiKey
properties.title: API Key
properties.description: Your own Transitland key: each device brings its own, none is shipped. The free plan is for non-commercial use. Test asks Transitland whether it accepts the key.

properties.name: stops
properties.title: My Stops
properties.description: The stops the transit pages and overlays can show, each under a name a task chooses it by. A stop is chosen from those near the device's location (System settings), or found by searching for its name (within 10 km of the device) or typing its key in the row's search box; Test asks Transitland for its name. The walk is how long it takes you to get there: a board leaves out what you could no longer catch.

properties.name: radius
properties.title: Stops Within
properties.description: How far from the device's location the stop list reaches when you choose a stop.

properties.name: departuresCacheMinutes
properties.title: Keep Departures
properties.description: How long what Transitland answered for a stop's departures (and the alerts that come with them) is kept and shared by every page, overlay and task of that stop. 15 at least: the free plan's 5,000 calls a month go only so far, so there is no 'ask every time'. A board shows how old its answer is.

properties.name: alertsCacheMinutes
properties.title: Keep Route Alerts
properties.description: How long the alerts of the routes that serve a stop are kept, for a Service Alerts task that asks for them (Route Alerts). They are a call of their own, so they are kept longer than the departures; a stop's own alerts come with its departures at no cost. 15 at least.

properties.name: lookupCacheHours
properties.title: Keep the Stop List
properties.description: How long the list of stops near the device is kept, so opening the form to choose a stop spends no calls.

properties.name: staleDays
properties.title: Forget Unused Answers After
properties.description: A kept answer nobody has used for this many days (a stop you removed) is removed. 0: never.

properties.name: monthlyQuota
properties.title: Monthly Quota
properties.description: The calls your Transitland plan allows in a month: 5,000 on the free plan. The System page's API usage card shows this period's calls against it, with a warning from 80%. Once it is used, Transitland is not asked again until the period resets, and what was kept is shown. Empty: no limit.

properties.name: quotaResetDay
properties.title: Quota Resets On
properties.description: The day of the month your plan starts counting again (1 to 28), in the device's time zone. Transitland does not say which day it is; the 1st is a guess.

properties.name: routineShare
properties.title: Routine Share
properties.description: The share of the monthly quota the boards may spend refreshing. Past it they show what was kept, and the rest is left for choosing and testing stops. 100: the boards may use all of it.
